name: xo-tag-automation
description: Tag-based VM automation for Xen Orchestra - performance tier enforcement, permission group assignment, and CSV-driven tag/notes management via NFS share
author: john olsen

configurationSchema.description: IMPORTANT -- The 'Delete configuration' button resets all plugin settings to their defaults. It does not delete any VMs, tags, groups, resource sets, or CSV files on your NFS share. It is safe to use if you want to reset the plugin configuration. It also clears the autopilotStartDate, which resets the Autopilot window.

tagSuffix.title: Tag Suffix
tagSuffix.description: Pool-specific suffix of performance tags, for granular control by pool (e.g. '-v' for POOL-V, '-1' for POOL-1).

schedule.title: Enforcement Schedule
schedule.description: How often to run Performance, CSV Sync, and Permission Autopilot.

dryRun.title: Dry-Run / Export-CSV
dryRun.description: When ON: previews all changes without applying them AND exports a fresh copy of all VM metadata to your CSV file (NewTags and NewNotes columns will be blank and ready to fill in). Check XO logs for full dry-run output. Turn OFF to apply changes for real.

enablePerformance.title: Enable Performance Enforcement
enablePerformance.description: Apply CPU weights and IO priorities based on VM performance tier tags (0-core, 1-high, 2-normal, 3-low).

enablePermissions.title: Enable Permission Sync
enablePermissions.description: Tags ending in -Admin / -Operator / -Viewer trigger group creation and ACL assignments. IMPORTANT: Verify your NFS share is properly configured and secured before enabling.

enablePermissionAutopilot.title: Enable Permission Autopilot
enablePermissionAutopilot.description: CSV-sourced permission enforcement. Reads -Admin/-Operator/-Viewer tags from current-vms.csv (CurrentTags column) and preload-vms.csv (Tags column) only -- does NOT read live VM tags. Runs on set schedule AND via Run Now. Set Autopilot Window to 0 to pause, or 1-4 to activate for that many weeks. IMPORTANT: Verify your NFS share is properly configured and secured before enabling.

autopilotWeeks.title: Autopilot Window (weeks)
autopilotWeeks.description: Number of weeks the Permission Autopilot will run from its start date. 0 = paused (instant off switch, window timer is preserved). 1-4 = active window (safety cap -- values above 4 are clamped to 4). Default is 0 -- you must intentionally set a value to activate.

autopilotStartDate.title: Autopilot Start Date (auto-set)
autopilotStartDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the Autopilot window began. Set automatically on the first Autopilot run. Clear this field to reset the window start date on the next run. Cleared automatically if you click 'Delete configuration'.

nfsSharePath.title: NFS Share Path
nfsSharePath.description: Base path to your NFS share directory. All plugin files are managed here automatically: current-vms.csv, preload-vms.csv, logs/xo-tag-automation.log, logs/xo-tag-automation-summary.log. Log files are automatically rotated at 2MB (one backup kept as xo-tag-automation.log.1).

stalenessWarnDays.title: CSV Age Warning (days)
stalenessWarnDays.description: Warn in logs if current-vms.csv has not been exported in this many days.

performanceTiers.title: Performance Tier Settings
performanceTiers.description: CPU weights and IO priorities per tier.
